topic: Rally joiner first slot and skill selection
consensus: Only first expedition skill of first-slot joiner hero contributes
At most four joiner skills are active
Higher-level first skills often described as displacing lower-level skills
At equal skill level, earlier join order commonly described as priority

conflicts.description: Some guides describe first four skills plus replacement after fifth joiner, others simply top four by level; special-case chance skills may differ
conflicts.resolution: Model level-first then order as conditional only

conflicts.description: One secondary guide calls Helga defensive in offensive rallies, but supplied in-game screenshots show her first expedition skill as all-squad attack
conflicts.resolution: Prefer screenshot for displayed skill text; game mode applicability remains to validate

conflicts.description: Third-party guides claim cross-group multiplication, but no official verified damage formula or real battle report calibration

needFromUser: A screenshot of a full rally participant skill list and battle result to validate selection and stacking
